tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje phag mo'i sa chog bzhugs so//

stegs kyi khar shar lho nas bzung mchod pa g.yon bskor bshams// slob dpon sa stegs kyi shar du zhal nub tu phyogs pas bzhugs la/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnam pa gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i myos byed la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis gsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddhonya haṃ/ zlum bskor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis chos 'byung dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/ thig le lnga bya/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ shar du ha sngon po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du sa ljang gu/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ chang gtor zhing*/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lag gnyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddhonya haṃ/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zlum bskor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis chos 'byung bya/ hrīḥha ri ni sa dbus dang phyogs bzhir thig le lnga bya/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ shar du ha sngon po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du sa ljang khu/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog

/sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/ nub tu ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa shrī badzra yo gi nī badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phros// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang gi lte ba'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam pa/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas rnams// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ra li hoḥbadzra wārā hī/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shyahoḥ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ shrī badzra wārā hī/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// dbu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra st+wa zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung rtse bsnams// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud ka bgegs 'dul mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skems shing pham mdzad ma// skyes gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams lag pa'i lha tshogs la thim/ lag pa'i lha tshogs rnams chang nang gi lha tshogs la thim pas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs nas phyogs mtshams su gtor zhing*/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ phyi rol gyi bgegs dang ma dag pa'i tshogs tshar bcad nas mkha' 'gro ma'i dra gur bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang la gtor la/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/

tshogs dang mchod rdzas la gtor la/ mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi mtshan smos la/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btags nas 'bul lo// rang gi lce thog tu bzhag nas bdud rtsi myang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ ༈ /oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs bdag bskyed yongs rdzogs bzlas pa bsdu ldang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ bar gsung*/ lha sta gon ni/ stegs bu'i steng gi nam mkhar bsangs te/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te smin mtshams nas bzung g.yon bskor byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddhonya haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rna ba g.yon nas g.yas kyi bar de nub slar rna ba g.yon du 'then pa gdan thabs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas smin mtshams nas rlung dang de nas bden bral slar smin mtshams su 'then pa khang thabs grub/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dbus su bdud rtsi 'thor/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ shar du bdud rtsi 'thor/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lhor bdud rtsi 'thor la/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nub tu bdud rtsi 'thor la/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ byang du bdud rtsi 'thor la/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/

brjod pas dbus dang phyogs bzhir thig le'i tshul du bdud rtsi'i thig pa reg la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas jo mo'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ de yang chos thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku bdud dpung gi tshogs la khros shing cher khros pa/ sku mdog dmar zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab cing rten pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing gar stabs su 'gying ba/ yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du sbyor bas kha ṭwāṃ ga mchan khung na yar bsgreng ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir rab tu gtum pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir khro gnyer dang mche ba rnam par brtsigs shing ma mchu tshems kyis mnan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la rigs lngas mtshan pa'i phyir thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa'i phyir thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/

me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o// gzhung du phyogs kyi padma 'dab bzhi la// 'byung bzhi bskyed pa'i sa bon las// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi bskyed// ces dang*/ zhal gdams kyi thog mar/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/ nub tu ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o// gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ snang ba chos sku'i gzhal yas nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos dbyings dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos sku spros bral dag pa la// longs sku sgyu ma'i skur bstan pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings nas bzhengs// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// bde chen dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// shes rab btsun mo'i bha ga nas// padma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// mchod rten dkar po'i dpal grags nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// ro langs 'khrug pa'i dur khrod nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// steng 'og phyogs mtshams so so nas// chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ra li hoḥbadzra wārā hī/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ buddhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ bi shwo ḍā ki nī ye/ lo kā ḍā ki nī ye/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bder bar ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wārā hī padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ shrī badzra wārā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ badzra wārā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod kyang 'bul/ de rnams kyi sku las rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gyi sku dpag tu med pa byon/ spyi bor thim/ bde ba dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi gsung las sngags ā li kā li dkar po dang dmar po'i phreng ba byung*/ mgrin par thim/ mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi thugs las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin byon/ snying gar thim/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lha mo de rnams rang rang gi sku la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mchod bzhi bzlas pa grub nas stegs kyi khar mchod kha gsos la/ oṃ shrī badzra wa ra hī badzra arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ a lo ke/

gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma taṅgi dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la= ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la= lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ slob dpon gyis spos dang rdor dril 'dzin cing thal mo sbyar nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pas rjes su gnang ba stsal zhing byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bris la rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin par gyur/ slar yang*/ oṃ shrī badzra wa ra hī badzra arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widya/ shabda/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma taṅgi dang*/ oṃ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skems shing pham mdzad ma// skyes gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i nam mkha'i khams de nyid du bzhugs par gyur/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog de nas thig gdab cing rdul mtshon gyi bya ba sogs legs par grub nas/

lhag chad brtag cing slob dpon gyis yig brgya gsung zhing bskor ba gsum gyi mthar/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas don dam ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo nyid du gyur/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wār badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bstim mo/ de nas dkyil 'khor nub tu phug gtor/ shar lho nas bzung mchod pa g.yon bskor/ ༈ /shar du bdud rtsi/ sngon gtor las bum ming dbang gri gug rdo rje/ ༈ /lhor dbu rgyan dar dpyang rin po che/ ༈ /nub tu rdo rje padma/ ༈ /byang du dril bu ral gri/ ༈ /dbus su bum pa mgul ching dmar po/ rkang gsum steng du thod pa bdud rtsi bcas/ de steng me long nang ngos la chos 'byung padma bris pa'i lte bar hrīḥl/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa ri ni ha sa sa ni ri ha sa ri ni ha a karṣa ya hrīḥdzaḥ zhes g.yon bskor du bris pa mkha' gro dbang bsdud yin/ me long phyir ngos su sindhu ri'i dkyil 'khor bris/ de'i steng du dar dmar gyi dkyil 'khor dbub gzungs rdor bzhag go sgrub pa'i skabs dkyil 'khor drug rtsegs go rdo rje phag mo'i rdul mtshon bsdu ba'i skabs/ lhag ma phul grub nas mchod bstod rgyas pa ni/ ༈ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin btibs gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra puṣpe sogs/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldang bas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dhū pe*/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke/ stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gandhe/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang ma bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai widye/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shabda/ pañtsa a mṝ ta āḥhūm̐/ badzra ma taṅgi ā hūm̐/ hrīḥ zhal gcig spyan gsum ljags 'dril zhing*// zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// sku mdog rab dmar 'od zer 'bar// snang stong skye med sku la bstod// 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa'i zhal// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs sgra sgrogs ma// grags stong dbyer med gsung la bstod// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'jigs byed dang*// dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i gdan steng na// sna tshogs me 'od bdud 'dul ma// rtog med mgo phreng can la bstod// g.yas na dam nyams srog gcod gri// g.yon na bdud rtsi ka pā la// rigs stong rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can// lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde stong bla ma yid bzhin gyi// nor bu gtsug gi rgyan ldan ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/

ces bstod do// ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon la bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'di'i// ma tshang ba dag bzod par mdzod/ ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas lhag chad nor 'khrul la sogs pa rnams bzod par gsol te/ thal mo sbyar bas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab cing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i shu kra mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol// da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la 'god// ces smon btab bo/ de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra wārā hī badzra muḥzhes ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs nas dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gnas su/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsdu/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhag pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng gnas pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha// dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba 'di yis nye bar mtshon nas ni// sems can rnams kyis dus gsum bsags pa yi// zag bcas zag med zung 'jug dge ba rnams// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang rtogs pa yis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas thob par shog oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna tātwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mchod sil ring ba'i 'og rdul mtshon bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gral du bzhugs la/ bkra shis ni/ bka' brgyud bla mas legs byin pa'i// rtag tu ye shes thugs rje yis// gzigs shing chos sku ngo sprod pa'i// byin brlabs mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje phag mos legs byin pa'i// gsang sngags mchog gi cho ga la// lus ngag yid gsum mthu grub pa'i// dngos grub mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// gnyis med dpe bral don rtogs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// chos rnams rang bzhin rang gi sems// rgyud 'di chos kyis ma bcings pa'i// chos kyi phyag rgya'i bkra shis shog /rin chen mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// yon tan dpag tu med pas brgyan// nad dang gdon las thar ba yi// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /padma mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyor// bde chen ye shes thabs kyi mchog

/gsang ba shes rab bkra shis shog /las kyi mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// 'gro ba'i bsam pa rab shes nas// thabs rnams du mas 'dul mdzad pa// mngon shes drug ldan bkra shis shog /dpa' bo rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// rdo rje gsum gyi 'od zer gyis// bgegs rigs stong phrag zhi ba dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /lha mo rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// 'byung ba lnga yi spro bsdu yis// bde bar gshegs pa mnyes mdzad pa'i// yang dag mchod pa'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// 'khor bzang longs spyod ldan pa dang*// nad dang gdon las thar ba yi// bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis ni/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sa steng yong la khyab// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bden pa grub cing sogs sam yang na// chos dbyings byang chub sogs so/// / ༈ karma legs bshad gling gi bshad grwa ru// bla ma bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya bas// gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang po'i mthus bskyed kyis// spar du bsgrubs dges 'gro kun 'tshang rgya shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge legs 'phel/
